knowledge_items.title: SPL distance and power scaling
knowledge_items.summary: Free-field inverse-distance loss and electrical power level scaling for initial amplifier budgeting.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Free field; sensitivity remains linear; room gain, compression, and distortion omitted.

knowledge_items.title: EBP topology screen
knowledge_items.summary: Use Fs/Qes only to shortlist sealed versus vented investigation; not an alignment or final choice.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Approximate screening rule; compare measured response, volume, excursion, and losses.

knowledge_items.title: Forward Thiele-Small derivation
knowledge_items.summary: Calculate composite T/S values from measured electrical/mechanical components and piston data.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Small-signal linear parameters; constants use local air-density/sound-speed defaults.

knowledge_items.title: Inverse composite T/S derivation
knowledge_items.summary: Derive motor/mechanical components from Fs/Qes/Qms/Re/BL/Sd and estimate reference sensitivity.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Derived values inherit rounding/error from input T/S values.

knowledge_items.title: Half-power impedance T/S estimate
knowledge_items.summary: Estimate Fs/Qes/Qms/Qts from Re, resonance impedance, and two prescribed flank frequencies.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Sensitive to nonlinear/irregular resonance peak and correct half-power crossing selection.

knowledge_items.title: Added-mass Mms method
knowledge_items.summary: Infer total moving mass from free-air and added-mass resonances.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Mass must be attached securely and symmetrically; low drive and repeatable mounting required.

knowledge_items.title: Delta-compliance sealed test-box method
knowledge_items.summary: Estimate Mms from free-air and sealed test-box resonance using box acoustic compliance.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Test box must be sealed and its actual air volume/driver geometry known.

knowledge_items.title: Series resistance Q correction
knowledge_items.summary: Include amplifier/cable/crossover series resistance when calculating effective Qes/Qts.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Effective series resistance is measured/reasonably bounded at operating conditions.

knowledge_items.title: Sealed-box alignment
knowledge_items.summary: Calculate sealed-box volume and response from target Qtc and driver T/S.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Small-signal lumped model; losses and stuffing require measured/calibrated treatment.

knowledge_items.title: Bass-reflex loss combination
knowledge_items.summary: Combine leakage, absorption, and port losses as reciprocal Q contributions.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Loss Q values are alignment/model inputs; not universal defaults.

knowledge_items.title: Helmholtz port geometry
knowledge_items.summary: Calculate effective/physical port length, correction, per-port dimensions, and pipe resonance.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Round-port end corrections do not transfer directly to slots, flares, or ports near walls.

knowledge_items.title: Port area and velocity screening
knowledge_items.summary: Screen total port area from driver displacement and chosen peak air-speed limit; calculate simulated port velocity separately.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Rule-of-thumb only; does not predict turbulence, compression, or audible noise.

knowledge_items.title: Rectangular room modes
knowledge_items.summary: Calculate axial/tangential/oblique modal frequencies for rectangular room dimensions.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Ideal rigid rectangular room; damping, openings, furnishings, and source/listener coupling are omitted.

knowledge_items.title: Single-boundary SBIR first null
knowledge_items.summary: Estimate first cancellation frequency for a source near one rigid boundary.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Single ideal rigid plane only; multi-boundary room response needs geometry and measurements.

knowledge_items.title: Baffle step and edge diffraction
knowledge_items.summary: Use width-only step estimates for initial screening; use per-driver diffraction and measured on-baffle FRD for final crossover work.
knowledge_items.equations: f_step ~= 115/W_m; full-space to forward-hemisphere level change ~= 6 dB
knowledge_items.assumptions: Width-only approximation excludes height, depth, driver location, edge radius, and nearby boundaries.

knowledge_items.title: Nearfield bass scaling and splice
knowledge_items.summary: Scale nearfield SPL using radiating area and splice against gated farfield/ground-plane data in an overlap region.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Approximation; source geometry, coherent timing, port/PR radiation, and splice method affect error.

knowledge_items.title: Gated farfield frequency resolution
knowledge_items.summary: Nominal lower useful resolution scales approximately with the inverse of the time window; inspect the impulse/reflection and overlap-splice low bass.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Window, SNR, reflections, and room affect practical resolution; this is not a sharp cutoff.

knowledge_items.title: Zobel and constant-impedance L-pad starts
knowledge_items.summary: Calculate first-pass impedance compensation and tweeter attenuation values, then remeasure actual branch impedance.
knowledge_items.equations: Zobel R~=1.25*Re; C=Le/R^2; Lpad requires series/shunt divider satisfying specified attenuation and load
knowledge_items.assumptions: Starting values only; driver impedance, component losses, and power ratings matter.

knowledge_items.title: Angular power averaging
knowledge_items.summary: Average acoustic power linearly using valid angular weights; sparse horizontal samples alone are not full-sphere sound power.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Requires appropriate angular sample set and integration weights.

knowledge_items.title: Acoustic-center path offset
knowledge_items.summary: Convert path-distance difference to time delay and use measured phase/timing where available.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Geometric estimate; sloped baffles are not equivalent to physical or DSP time alignment at all angles.

knowledge_items.title: Design package provenance
knowledge_items.summary: Hash the brief, configs, measurements, and fitted parameter inputs; calculation configs may still refer to external workspace files.
knowledge_items.assumptions: Manifest is auditable but not self-contained/portable unless all external inputs are copied and paths rewritten.

knowledge_items.title: Prompt normalization gate
knowledge_items.summary: Natural-language requests must be normalized into explicit schema v1 fields before deterministic calculations; the CLI does not infer values from free text.
knowledge_items.assumptions: The language agent may propose field mappings but must ask the user to confirm ambiguous values.

workflow_stages.title: Define goals
workflow_stages.gate: Do not choose parts until targets and units are explicit.

workflow_stages.title: User-selected driver data
workflow_stages.gate: Bind every model branch to the user-selected identity; no substitutions.

workflow_stages.title: Enclosure calculation
workflow_stages.gate: Check volume, impedance, F3, excursion, port/PR behavior, and model limits.

workflow_stages.title: Geometry and build package
workflow_stages.gate: Do not infer missing dimensions or displacements.

workflow_stages.title: Finished-baffle measurements
workflow_stages.gate: Reject missing requested angles/ranges; distinguish user metadata from file-verified coverage.

workflow_stages.title: Complex crossover design
workflow_stages.gate: Check summed response, phase, impedance, angle coverage, and user impedance floor.

workflow_stages.title: Build and verify
workflow_stages.gate: Simulation is not physical or safety certification.

limitations.description: No BL(x), Cms(x), hysteresis, harmonic/intermodulation distortion, or large-signal motor/suspension model.
limitations.needed: Large-signal parameter curves or specialized nonlinear measurements/models.

limitations.description: Power ceilings are estimates; voice-coil temperature/time/compression is not modeled.
limitations.needed: Thermal time constants, resistance-vs-temperature, airflow, and power test data.

limitations.description: Rectangular modal and single-boundary SBIR equations are estimates, not full room simulation.
limitations.needed: Room geometry, source/listener locations, boundary properties, and in-room measurements.

limitations.description: No live sound-card/audio-interface impedance acquisition in the CLI.
limitations.needed: External REW/V/I measurement and exported complex ZMA.

limitations.description: Sparse horizontal samples are not a full-sphere CTA-2034 spinorama.
limitations.needed: Complete horizontal/vertical/rear angle data with standardized weights.

limitations.description: The cited BB4/other LDC table entries are not fully implemented; do not guess unreadable lookup values.
limitations.needed: Verified table data or a validated derivation.

limitations.description: The workflow produces dimensions/notes/configs but does not generate universal parametric CAD for arbitrary driver sets.
limitations.needed: Driver geometry, selected CAD template, print/material constraints, and clearance validation.

limitations.description: The command-line workflow consumes schema-v1 JSON rather than parsing free-form natural language itself.
limitations.needed: Agent-mediated normalization and user confirmation of ambiguous fields.

limitations.description: The provenance manifest hashes measurement inputs, but package configs can still reference external absolute/workspace paths.
limitations.needed: Bundle measurement/config dependencies and rewrite paths for a portable archive.
